comments.text: There's just not enough demand to warrant all these data centers and energy. Note that all datacenters in AI are producing electricity with fossil fuels (or at least not clean sources). Companies like Google that publish their metrics on climate action have deferred their dates to multiple years in the future because of the additional non-green compute. To put things into perspective: gpt-5-nano or mini are good enough for 99% of the use cases. The only 2 use cases where we need cutting edge models are for scientific research and coding. But does that warrant hundreds of billions of dollars of investment into one company with circular money siphoning and company ownership? Heck no. Especially when considering that Chinese open source models can perform almost as good as OpenAI's. This is a HUGE AI bubble.
